title: Spain approves housing measures a day after massive street protests

ai.summary: Spain's interim housing minister said the right to housing won on streets and workplaces after a general strike, with measures to limit evictions approved but their duration dependent on November election.

facts.claim: Spain's interim housing minister said the right to housing won on streets and workplaces after a general strike
facts.quote: ‘Yesterday, the right to housing on the street and in workplaces, and I hope it will win again at the ballot box,’ interim Housing Minister Isabel Rodriguez told lawmakers

facts.claim: Spain's government approved measures to limit evictions
facts.quote: Spain’s interim lower house of parliament on Thursday ratified housing measures designed to limit evictions and real estate speculation

facts.claim: The measures' duration depends on November election
facts.quote: The duration of the approved measures, however, will likely depend on the outcome of a national election set for later this month

facts.claim: The opposition party said it will repeal the housing measures if it takes power
facts.quote: The leading opposition party, the conservative Popular Party, has said that it will repeal the housing measures of the left-wing government if it takes power
